summary: Nothing in the image decides a mission win or loss. The native side offers the mission script four write paths (objective state, the per-slot scoring record, the end-of-mission movie object at game+7188h, and the state request queue) and one poll, 004d7ea0, that turns the last of those into state request 0Fh. The five addresses docs/MISSION_EVENTS_UPDATE.md proposed as mission_failure_decision are unit-subsystem damage simulation (0093bed0, 0093c300, 0095abe0) and unit-death reporting (007f3b10, 00959450); none of them reads or writes an objective, the scoring record, game+7188h or the request queue.

flow_gaps_reported_not_repaired.effect: 00bf65ac is annotated no-return, so the decompiler ends the free branch with a return and shows 004cd390 as free-or-create. The listing has no RET there: the branch falls through into PUSH 0x24 / operator new at 004cd3e4, so the behaviour is free-then-create.
same no-return annotation; a second 3-byte gap after a JMP at 008cd67b is not after a CALL and was left alone

uncertainties: 00927f60's role. It stamps the clock into entity+1D0h and propagates it to at most five formation members through [entity+9D4h]+3D0h; 'AI re-target kick' reads the shape, it is not established behaviour.
The two trailing arguments of 008e20d0 / 008e2200 pass through 008e1d30 and the replication message builders unread by anything decoded here.

008cd440's Lua argument order. It reads an integer, an optional integer, three strings and an optional boolean, but passes two strings, an int and a byte to the constructor; the third string goes to 008dbf40. The header models the record, not the call.
[game+19CCh]+4ACh, the gate both kill reporters share, has no identified writer (docs/UNIT_INSTANCE_UPDATE.md also leaves it open).
004cd390's +8h float from 00ce77e4 is called a score by game_frame_control.hpp; the constant was not read and the name is inherited, not established.
0093bed0's component floats at +28h/+2Ch are called a rate and a period on the strength of the division; the descriptor was not decoded.
